# FAQ-021 Engineering FAQ #21

Revision: Rev A

Q: What is the required spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) before starting precision cuts?
A: Warm the spindle for 27 minutes. Follow the warm-up procedure in SOP-P1-L3-04 for verification of runout and thermal stability.

Q: How often must the main roll bearing on Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) be lubricated during continuous operation?
A: Lubricate the main roll bearing at intervals of 120 hours of operation. Record lubrication actions in the equipment log per SOP-P1-L1-02.

Q: What spindle warm-up time is specified for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) when preparing for die-fit operations?
A: Warm the spindle for 21 minutes to reach stable thermal conditions before critical machining. Confirm following SOP-P1-L1-02 and SOP-P1-L3-04 as applicable.

Q: What is the alarm setpoint for dust collector pressure drop on Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03)?
A: The dust collector pressure drop alarm is set at 1510 Pa. If the alarm actuates, inspect filters and ducting and follow corrective steps in SOP-P3-L4-02.

Q: What is the minimum acceptable coil cooling water flow for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) to prevent coil overheating?
A: Maintain a minimum flow of 55 L/min. If flow falls below this value, stop induction heating and follow cooling and inspection procedures referenced in SOP-P1-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L4-02.

Related documents: SOP-P1-L1-02, SOP-P1-L3-04, SOP-P3-L4-02
